conceptual_change: Incorporate a volatility-gate mechanism by requiring the 14-period ATR to exceed 1.5 times the 20-period moving average of the ATR as a mandatory filter for trade entry signals.
evidence_sources: research/BTCUSDT_1h_result_v2.json: dataset and baseline execution provenance
rationale: The previous hypothesis was rejected due to a lack of engine implementation; this hypothesis formalizes the volatility gate as a primary filter to improve signal reliability during high-volatility trending regimes as originally conceptualized.
